title: Use the open-sourced Zephyr: Special project prompts and assets as a reference…
content: Use the open-sourced Zephyr: Special project prompts and assets as a reference to learn how Seedance 2.5 was used, then adapt those prompts/assets to build your own scenes and characters.
tips: Use the open-sourced Zephyr: Special project prompts and assets as a reference to learn how Seedance 2.5 was used, then adapt those prompts/assets to build your own scenes and characters.

en.content:
Use the open-sourced Zephyr: Special project prompts and assets as a reference to learn how Seedance 2.5 was used, then adapt those prompts/assets to build your own scenes and characters.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Zephyr: Special, the new episode of our K-pop action series, featuring @hay_nyash, is open-sourced for the $1,000,000 Higgsfield Global Film Festival.

Every prompt and asset is now public – Seedance 2.5 pushed to the max.

Study them and build your own worlds with your favorite characters.
---

es.content:
Usa Zephyr: Special, de código abierto, como referencia para aprender cómo se utilizó Seedance 2.5, y luego adapta esos prompts/assets para crear tus propias escenas y personajes.

--- TUIT CITADO ---
Zephyr: Special, el nuevo episodio de nuestra serie de acción K-pop, con @hay_nyash, se ha publicado como código abierto para el Higgsfield Global Film Festival de $1,000,000.

Cada prompt y asset ahora es público: Seedance 2.5 llevado al máximo.

Estúdialos y construye tus propios mundos con tus personajes favoritos.

fr.content:
Utilisez les prompts et assets open source de Zephyr: Special comme référence pour apprendre comment Seedance 2.5 a été utilisé, puis adaptez ces prompts/assets pour créer vos propres scènes et personnages.

--- TWEET CITÉ ---
Zephyr: Special, le nouvel épisode de notre série d’action K-pop, avec @hay_nyash, est open source pour le Higgsfield Global Film Festival doté de 1 000 000 $.

Chaque prompt et asset est désormais public — Seedance 2.5 poussé à son maximum.

Étudiez-les et construisez vos propres univers avec vos personnages préférés.

ko.content:
오픈소스로 공개된 Zephyr: Special 프로젝트의 prompt와 assets를 참고해 Seedance 2.5가 어떻게 사용되었는지 학습한 다음, 그 prompt/assets를 응용해 자신만의 장면과 캐릭터를 만들어 보세요.

--- 인용된 트윗 ---
Zephyr: Special, @hay_nyash가 출연한 우리의 K-pop 액션 시리즈의 새로운 에피소드가 $1,000,000 Higgsfield Global Film Festival을 위해 오픈소스로 공개되었습니다.

이제 모든 prompt와 asset이 공개되었습니다. Seedance 2.5를 한계까지 끌어올렸습니다.

이를 연구하고, 좋아하는 캐릭터들과 함께 자신만의 세계를 만들어 보세요.
---

pt.content:
Use o projeto open-source Zephyr: Special, com prompts e assets, como referência para aprender como o Seedance 2.5 foi usado e, depois, adapte esses prompts/assets para criar suas próprias cenas e personagens.

--- TWEET CITADO ---
Zephyr: Special, o novo episódio da nossa série de ação K-pop, com @hay_nyash, foi disponibilizado em open source para o Higgsfield Global Film Festival de US$ 1.000.000.

Cada prompt e asset agora é público — Seedance 2.5 levado ao máximo.

Estude-os e crie seus próprios mundos com seus personagens favoritos.
---

zh.content:
参考开源的 Zephyr: Special 项目提示词和素材，了解 Seedance 2.5 是如何被使用的，然后基于这些提示词/素材，构建你自己的场景和角色。

--- 引用推文 ---
Zephyr: Special，我们的 K-pop 动作系列新一集， featuring @hay_nyash，已为 100 万美元的 Higgsfield Global Film Festival 开源。

现在每一条 prompt 和每一份素材都已公开——Seedance 2.5 被发挥到了极致。

研究它们，并用你最喜欢的角色构建你自己的世界。
